sections.Profile:
The "Buttons and Bows" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in March 1949, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Society, Wood Rail, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Roy Parker
- Design: Harry Mabs
sections.Editions: - Buttons and Bows: 2,200 made, released 1949-03-01, model number 19
